title: venom-advanced-cli
tagline: Venom dev ecosystem is growing, we need quick tools to get started with. We built a CLI tool to start frotnend with venom quickly with Next and React. More features like transaction scanner and CLI wallet to interact with the network also there.
description:
One of the main components of the project is a Command Line Interface (CLI) tool. This tool is designed to facilitate the creation of frontend applications using Next.js and React, which are popular frameworks for building web applications. It allows developers to quickly generate frontend boilerplate code, providing a starting point for their Venom projects. This feature aims to save developers time and effort by automating the setup and configuration process.

Additionally, the CLI tool offers more advanced features. It includes a transaction scanner, which likely enables developers to monitor and track transactions occurring within the Venom network. This feature could be useful for debugging, auditing, or analyzing the network's transaction activity.
how_its_made:
The CLI tool is built using TypeScript. It leverages Venom libraries, which are specific libraries developed for interacting with the Venom network.
Transaction Scanner Integration: The CLI tool utilizes the Venom libraries to interact with the Venom network's APIs or blockchain infrastructure. It connects to the network, retrieves transaction data, and processes it for scanning and analysis.
